newsitem.title: UK: Hyder says Swalec to materially enhance year.
newsitem.headline: Hyder says Swalec to materially enhance year.

text.p: British multi-utility Hyder Plc said its acquisition of regional electricity company South Wales Electricity (Swalec) should be "materially earnings enhancing on a full year basis." Hyder, which was formed when Welsh Water took over Swalec at the start of the year, said half year pretax profits rose 25 percent to 100.7 million pounds ($169.5 million) and paid out a dividend of 14.6 pence per share.

Hyder said costs were falling according to its assessments before the acquisition and added that the merger of service activities "has already produced synergy savings ahead of target." It added that unregulated activities had produced "encouraging profits" of 13.1 million pounds before interest, up from 0.6 million pounds a year ago.
It said a review of assets and liabilities acquired with Swalec had resulted in an increase of 6.5 million pounds to 574.5 miillion pounds in goodwill arising from the acquisition.
"By any objective measure, these are excellent results for the first half year," said chairman Iain Evans.
